notes: Curated condition registry (DATA_SCHEMA_SPEC §2.9). Every entry cites a wiki page (wikiTitle) whose existence is checked by the fetch stage; descriptions are definitional and carry no numbers that are not on the cited page.

match.stations: recipe station tokens (Cargo Recipes `station`, split on ' and '). match.recipeNotes: Cargo Recipes `resulttext` note keys (texts in Module:Recipes/l10n en.result_note). match.dropNotes: parenthesized note texts in Cargo Drops rate/custom cells (markup stripped).

satisfiedByNode values are references into the progression graph (P2-S6, overlays/progression.json + bosses.json) and are hard-checked. World-state conditions map to the node that makes them true: boss-defeat conditions to the boss node, "hardmode" to the Hardmode milestone (required-gated by wall-of-flesh) and post-mechanical-bosses to the all-mechanical-bosses milestone, so gatedBy.stage is the stage the condition opens (a Hardmode-only item is early-hm, not the late-prehm of the Wall of Flesh fight).
